AttachmentsConfig.description: Operator settings for remote attachment storage.

base_url.description: Public download URL. An `env:NAME` value is resolved before validation.

TargetConfig.description: A storage target. The variant name is an operator config key.

endpoint.description: Storage URL. An `env:NAME` value is resolved before validation.

key_prefix.description:
The prefix can be empty. Other prefixes use ASCII letters, digits,
`_`, `-`, `.`, and slash separators. A trailing slash is allowed.
Leading slashes, empty interior segments, and `.` or `..` segments are invalid.
An `env:NAME` value is resolved before validation.

CredentialsConfig.description: Credential source for signing. Debug never prints its fields.

enabled.description:
Check a credential on every RPC except the unauthenticated health and
configuration services. Required whenever `[auth]` is present; false
leaves every other field in this section unread.

jwks_url.description: Fetch signing keys from HTTPS, or HTTP on a loopback host.

keys.description: Inline public signing keys. Cannot be combined with jwks_url.

api_keys.description: Named static API keys. Values can be supplied with env:NAME.

audiences.description: Require an audience that matches one of these values when set.

issuers.description: Require an issuer that matches one of these values when set.

required_scopes.description: Require every one of these scopes on every authenticated RPC.

jwks_max_stale_seconds.description: Must be at least the refresh interval plus the ten-second fetch timeout.

public_key.description: PEM SubjectPublicKeyInfo for the selected algorithm, or env:NAME.

identifier.description:
Stable operator-chosen name for this deployment, by convention reverse
DNS such as `org.xmtp.dev`. Clients bind to it on first connect, so it
must never change once clients have connected. Required.

min_libxmtp_version.description:
Oldest libxmtp version this deployment accepts. Absent publishes no
minimum. Prerelease tags are ignored when clients compare.

log_level.description: Global backend log level. Request summaries and mutations use INFO.

request_logger.description: Emit one summary when each gRPC response finishes or is cancelled.

LogLevel.description: Configuration and CLI representation of the shared logging levels.

LogFormat.description: Stdout encoding. Each JSON event occupies one line.

TelemetryConfig.description: Metrics and optional OTLP export. Endpoint values are never included in errors.

metrics_listen.description: Separate Prometheus listener. An empty string disables the listener.

otlp_endpoint.description: OTLP gRPC endpoint; absent uses OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT.

recipient_ttl_seconds.description: Time without renewal before a recipient expires, in seconds.

max_attempts.description: Maximum provider attempts for each delivery.

apns.description: APNs is available only when this block is present.

fcm.description: FCM is available only when this block is present.

http.description: HTTPS webhooks are available only when this block is present.

key.description: PKCS#8 PEM credential; accepts an env:NAME reference.

bundle_id.description: Application bundle identifier used as the APNs topic.

service_account.description: Service-account JSON credential; accepts an env:NAME reference.

allowed_domains.description: Allowed hosts, with an optional leading *. wildcard. Absent allows all hosts.

allow_private_addresses.description: Permit private and local network addresses. Defaults to false.

max_push_topics.description: Maximum stored topics for one push recipient.

MlsConfig.description:
Advisory group shapes published to clients. The backend enforces none of
them; a client applies them before it builds a commit.

commit_log_enabled.description:
Publish and read the remote commit log. False switches both off for
every client of this deployment.
